steps.title: Anchor the clock and identify the run: resolve Mongo _id 6a8593320f3d4281bd8a0df0 (stg) to client/instance/integration + collector run window; convert the PI graph window to UTC
Collector side: what was published to S3 for this run - shard count, bytes, envelope/record counts, findings count, duplication
Glue side: locate the cybi-parser job run for this instance - DPUs, executors, duration, logs, rows written to assets/exposures

Code side: trace the write path (dal/dbManager.py) - insert statement shape, batch size, JDBC options, Spark partition count / concurrent writers, upsert/conflict handling, indexes on integration.parser_output_exposures

Code side: trace the row-multiplication path for the Tenable correlated lane (CVE explode, per-plugin/per-port findings, chunk envelope handling) and quantify fan-out from collector findings to exposure rows
Reconcile the numbers: expected vs actual rows; volume-vs-shape decomposition against the PI metrics (58.59 AAS, 1.39 calls/sec, 177.29 rows/sec, 117.43 ms/call, ~280 AAS peak vs ~10 vCPU)
Comparative baseline: same parser on earlier runs and/or other parsers of similar volume - is this anomalous or steady-state
Write the report (root cause with numbers, ranked contributing factors, what a fix would target)

notes: verifier-1: PASS-WITH-GAPS. 2 HIGH repaired (measured peak 327.46 AAS restored; WriteThroughput-derived '% of payload written' withdrawn), 5 MED repaired (screenshot-reproduction overclaim, A12 refutation, 2 speculation labels, 3-way-split completeness disclosure, volume-floor error bar), 4 LOW repaired (param-read fix item, RDS Proxy 457/536 no-pooling finding, task-count corroboration wording, state.json staleness).

Independent of the verifier, the operator asked for a more specific RCA; measurement of additional_fields against the parser's real exclusion set corrected 14,803 B/row (86.7 GB) to 10,437 B/row (61.1 GB) and identified plugin.xrefs + plugin.see_also as 63% of the payload with a >=74x redundancy factor. Recorded in rca.md.
